system.terrain: Hydra, Regenerating Hydra: Swamp. Sea Hydra: Lake, Ocean. Flying Hydra: Mountain.
system.description: Armor Class: 5 Hit Dice: 5-12 (1 per head) (L) Move: 120' (40') Attacks: 5-12 bites (1 per head) Damage: 1d10 each No. Appearing: 1 (1) Save As: F5-12 Morale: 11 Treasure Type: B Intelligence: 2 Alignment: Neutral XP Value: 175, 275, 450, 650, 900, 1,000, 1,100, or 1,250 Monster Type: Monster (Rare). A hydra is a large creature with a dragonlike body and 5-12 snakelike heads. It has one Hit Die for each head, and each head has 8 hit points. Its saving throws are as a fighter level equal to the number of heads.
